description: Uniswap V3 liquidity distribution for an Ethereum pool, read on-chain: tokens, fee tier, tick spacing, current tick and price (both directions, decimals applied), in-range liquidity, and every initialized tick within a window around the price with its price, liquidityNet and the active liquidity of the range above it — the shape of concentrated liquidity. Default pool: USDC/WETH 0.05%. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

pool.description: Uniswap V3 pool address on Ethereum (default USDC/WETH 0.05%)

words.description: Tick-bitmap words to scan each side of the price, 1 to 5 (default 2; one word = 256 tick spacings)

name: crypto_uniswap_v3_ticks
title: Crypto Uniswap V3 Ticks
